The color palette consists of crisp whites (#FFFFFF), warm creams (#F0E6D3), deep coral (#D4536D), and charcoal blacks (#1A1A1A), with lifted shadows and warm highlights. 

[Shot 1] The video begins with the starting frame from <Image 1>, showing <Subject 1> standing on a busy Manhattan crosswalk during the day. She is positioned profile-view, looking into the reflection of a glass storefront window. The city behind her is softly blurred, with moving traffic and pedestrians. The atmosphere is airy and high-end. 

[Shot 2] At 00:01.500, the camera performs a quick, short push-in toward <Subject 1>. She uses the slightly smudged glass window as a mirror to check her appearance. She brings her hand into the frame as she carefully applies <Subject 2> to her lips. The focus sharpens on the tactile texture of the lipstick and the pop of the coral color against her neutral black attire. The reflection in the glass shows her movements clearly while the city life continues to flow in the soft-focus background.
